name: NEXUS Retention Purge (TENANT SCOPED - PROPOSAL, DRY RUN)

nodes.name: Every Night 03:00
nodes.notes: Same 03:00 Asia/Dubai slot as the original. This workflow ships with active:false and DRY RUN on; it deletes nothing until both are deliberately changed.

nodes.name: Read Run Mode
nodes.notes: Single source of truth for DRY_RUN and the prefix check. Both default ON (safe). Unset or unreadable env = dry run.

nodes.name: List Dealerships
nodes.notes: Active dealerships only. The quarantine / unattributed tenant is filtered out in the next node rather than in the URL, so the reason is visible in the run.

nodes.name: Enumerate Dealerships
nodes.notes: Excludes the quarantine/unattributed tenant. Emits one item per real dealership.

nodes.name: For Each Dealership
nodes.notes: batchSize 1. Every dealership is purged on its own, with its own counts, its own audit row and its own Slack channel. Output 0 = done (roll-up), output 1 = one dealership.

nodes.name: Find Expired Documents (Tenant)
nodes.notes: THE FIX. tenant_id=eq.<t> is the predicate the original had no equivalent of. select now also returns tenant_id so the next node can re-check ownership rather than trust the filter.

nodes.name: Plan + Verify Scope
nodes.notes: Re-checks ownership on every returned row AND requires the tenant prefix on every path. Either failure abandons this dealership's batch without deleting anything.

nodes.name: Delete For Real?
nodes.notes: TRUE only when the batch is in scope, non-empty, AND DRY_RUN is off. Every other combination goes to the dry-run reporter and deletes nothing.

nodes.name: Delete Storage Objects (Tenant)
nodes.notes: Only ever reached with a batch whose every path was proven to start with kyc/<this tenant>/. The 'prefixes' parameter name is Supabase's own; the reconcile node below still checks for objects deleted that were NOT requested.

nodes.name: Dry Run Report
nodes.notes: The dry-run half. Reports WOULD-delete counts per dealership and deletes nothing.

nodes.name: Reconcile (Tenant)
nodes.notes: Per dealership. Absence from the delete response means NOT DELETED. Also flags any deleted object that does not carry this dealership's prefix.

nodes.name: Anything Confirmed Deleted?
nodes.notes: TRUE = at least one object confirmed gone, so its ids may be marked. FALSE = skip the PATCH entirely; id=in.() is a malformed PostgREST filter.

nodes.name: Mark Rows Purged (Tenant)
nodes.notes: THE FIX. tenant_id=eq.<t> on the PATCH, so a compliance field cannot be written across dealerships even if the id list were wrong. purged_at=is.null makes it idempotent - a re-run cannot overwrite an earlier, truthful purge timestamp. ids are still only the ones Storage CONFIRMED it deleted.

nodes.name: Prune Dedupe Guard (Tenant)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ p_tenant_id: $('For Each Dealership').first().json.tenant_id, p_older_than: $('For Each Dealership').first().json.DEDUPE_DAYS + ' days', p_dry_run: $('For Each Dealership').first().json.DRY_RUN }) }}

nodes.notes: THE FIX. Was an unscoped DELETE /rest/v1/processed_messages?processed_at=lt.<now-7d> that cleared every dealership's dedupe ledger in one statement. Now an RPC that takes a dealership, honours the dry run, and is the only sanctioned delete path once the guard in PROPOSED_guard_extension.sql section A is applied. THAT MIGRATION MUST BE APPLIED FOR THIS NODE TO WORK - until then the function does not exist and this node 404s.

nodes.name: Find Archive Gaps (Tenant)
nodes.notes: Scoped to this dealership. The original also carried a hard-coded created_at floor of 2026-08-17T16:01:48Z - a one-off cut-off for one dealership's history, which would silently hide a second dealership's older gaps. Removed.

nodes.name: Read Tenant Config
nodes.notes: select=* on purpose. The Slack channel column does not exist yet (see the resolve node); selecting it by name would 400. This reads whatever the row has and the next node picks the field if it is there.

nodes.name: Resolve Slack Channel
nodes.notes: Per-dealership channel if one is ever configured; otherwise the shared channel WITH the dealership named and the sharing disclosed in the message itself.

nodes.name: Any Gaps To Report?
nodes.notes: No gaps, no Slack post. Silence here is a true statement.

nodes.name: Slack: Archive Gap Alert (Tenant)
nodes.notes: Channel comes from the resolve node, not a constant.

nodes.name: Summarise Dealership
nodes.notes: One audit row per dealership, with its own status. DRY_RUN and REJECTED are first-class statuses, not dressed up as SUCCESS.

nodes.name: Log Dealership Purge to Audit
nodes.notes: Written per dealership, BEFORE the run is allowed to go red. A shortfall reaches the compliance record even if a later node stops the workflow.

nodes.name: Roll Up All Dealerships
nodes.notes: Aggregate verdict. A single FAILED or REJECTED dealership makes the whole run FAILED - an average is not a compliance statement.

nodes.name: Run Clean?
nodes.notes: Runs AFTER the audit rows are written, on purpose: the record is on file before the run is allowed to go red.

parameters.errorMessage: Tenant-scoped retention purge did not fully verify for at least one dealership. The per-dealership audit_log rows were written FIRST, so every shortfall is already on the compliance record before this stop: each names its dealership, its requested / deleted / unaccounted counts, and every storage_path still sitting in the kyc-documents bucket. purged_at was written ONLY for objects Supabase confirmed it deleted, and only with tenant_id=eq.<that dealership> on the PATCH. Every unaccounted row is deliberately left unmarked so the next run selects it again. Absence from Supabase Storage's bulk-delete response means NOT DELETED - it never means fine. A REJECTED status means a batch was abandoned because it could not be proven in scope; that is the guard working, not a malfunction. This stop exists so the execution shows red and reaches the error workflow; it undoes nothing and suppresses no audit row.

_proposal.author: agent PURGE-FIX
_proposal.status: PROPOSAL ONLY - NOT IMPORTED, NOT ACTIVE, NOT RUN
_proposal.replaces: n8n-workflows/nexus_retention_purge.json (n8n id aIYwwoYStDAi9kHy, active, runs 03:00 Asia/Dubai)
_proposal.warning: Importing this and switching it on CHANGES WHAT RUNS NIGHTLY. It needs Ali's explicit yes. It ships active:false and dry-run-by-default so that an accidental import deletes nothing.
_proposal.hard_dependency: The node 'Prune Dedupe Guard (Tenant)' calls public.nexus_prune_processed_messages(uuid, interval, boolean), which does NOT exist on production yet. It is defined in ops/destructive-scope/PROPOSED_guard_extension.sql section A3. Without that migration this node 404s every run (reported per dealership as PARTIAL, not silently swallowed).
_proposal.known_limitation_paths: Production KYC object keys are kyc/YYYY/MM/uuid.ext and carry no tenant segment (9 of 9 rows, measured 2026-09-17). With NEXUS_PURGE_REQUIRE_TENANT_PREFIX at its default of on, EVERY batch is abandoned with status REJECTED and nothing is deleted. That is deliberate. See PROPOSED_storage_path_tenant_segment.md.
_proposal.known_limitation_slack: There is no per-dealership Slack channel column in the database. Alerts still post to the shared channel C0BKTLL1X54 but are labelled with the dealership and disclose the sharing in the message text. Add tenant_configuration.slack_alert_channel_id and this workflow uses it with no further change.

env.NEXUS_PURGE_DRY_RUN: default 'true'. ONLY the exact string 'false' arms the deletes. Requires N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false on the n8n container for $env to be readable; if it is not, every read falls back and the workflow stays in dry run.
env.NEXUS_PURGE_REQUIRE_TENANT_PREFIX: default 'true'. Every storage path must start with kyc/<tenant>/ or the batch is abandoned.
env.NEXUS_PURGE_BATCH_LIMIT: default '500', per dealership rather than globally - so one dealership can no longer starve another out of the nightly run.

changes_from_original: Iterates dealerships explicitly (List Dealerships -> Enumerate -> splitInBatches batchSize 1); excludes the quarantine / unattributed tenant.
tenant_id=eq.<t> added to the expired-document read, the archive-gap read and the purged_at PATCH.
PATCH also carries purged_at=is.null, so a re-run cannot overwrite an earlier truthful purge timestamp.
Every returned row's tenant_id is re-checked against the dealership asked for; a mismatch abandons the batch.
Every storage path must start with kyc/<tenant>/ before any delete (flag-controlled, default on).
The unscoped DELETE on processed_messages is replaced by a per-dealership, dry-runnable RPC.
Slack channel resolved per dealership, with the shared-channel fallback disclosed in the message.
Removed the hard-coded created_at floor 2026-08-17T16:01:48Z from the archive-gap query - a one-dealership artefact that would hide a second dealership's older gaps.
DRY RUN mode: reports per-dealership WOULD-delete counts and deletes nothing.
One audit_log row per dealership plus a roll-up; DRY_RUN and REJECTED are first-class statuses.
The batch limit is per dealership rather than a single global 500.
